tei:div.tei:p: // bcom ldan 'das ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sgo nas don gnyis sgrub pa 'chi med kyi 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

bcom ldan 'das ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sgo nas don gnyis sgrub pa 'chi med kyi 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo// phyag 'tshal bde chen ster ma myur ma ste// lnga pa'i klad pa 'gems la rab dpa' ma// chu shel lhun po lta bur mdzes sdug can// mtshan dpe'i rgyan ldan oṃ mdzad lha mo'i lha// 'dir bcom ldan 'das ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i gdams pa la gnyis/ brgyud pa'i rim pa dang*/ de las byung ba'o| |dang po ni/ bcom ldan 'das ma/ rdo rje gdan pa/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ bla ma gle nag pa/ dge bshes sgre ba/ zur mkhar ba/ rje sgam po pa/ dpal phag mo gru pa/ stag lung thang pa/ bla ma ba lam pa/ slob dpon shākya gzhon nu/ slob dpon bla ma/ rtogs ldan grags seng ba/ mkhas grub dar rgyas pa/ chos rje mkha' spyod dbang po/ 'khrul zhig bsod nams 'bum/ slob dpon bla ma rgyal mtshan/ zhwa dmar ba bzhi pa chos kyi grags pa/ chos rje shes rab dpal ldan/ bla ma kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ mtshungs med chos rgyal phun tshogs/ des bdag chos kyi grags pa la/ yang na/ rje btsun mas rjes su gnang ste/ ngag dbang grags pa/ gser gling pa/ a ti sha/ 'brom ston pa/ spyan snga ba/ dge bshes sgre ba/ phag gru phyin 'dra/ yang na/ 'phags ma/ paṇa chen shākya shrī/ dā na shrī/ btsan thang ka pa la/ rtogs ldan grags seng phyin gong ltar ro// gnyis pa brgyud pa de las byung ba'i gdams pa ni/ rang gzhan gyi don du sku gnyis sgrub pa yin la/ de sgrub pa'i rten ni chos bco brgyad dang ldan pa'i lus rten kho na gtso che zhing*/ de nyid yun ring du gnas pa'i thabs tshe sring ba gal che ste/ slob dpon ngag dbang grags pas/ 'khor ba srog las gces pa ni// mi gang yod pa ma mthong ste// de bas myur du thabs mang pos// 'chi ba bslu ba kun tu spyad// ces gsungs/ ji ltar spyod ce na/ de nyid kyis/ gang phyir rig pa thabs sbyar bas// dka' ba cung zad yod ma yin// zhes gsungs/

'o na rig pa thabs sbyar ba'i tshul ji lta bu zhe na/ de la gnyis/ bdag don sgrub pa dang*/ gzhan don sgrub pa'o// dang po la gsum/ bsnyen pa/ de'i kha skong sbyin sreg /sgrub cing mchod pa'i rim pa'o// dang po la gsum/ sngon du bya ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po ni/ ra ba bzhi la sogs dkar phyogs yan lag lnga pa'i 'bras bu rgyas pa'i las la shis pa'i dus/ gnas khang bkra shis par byi dor dang*/ bla bres yol ba bris par/ bcom ldan 'das ma'i bris sku rab gnas dang ldan pa'i mdun du/ kha na ma tho ba dang bral pa'i gtor ma zar gong lta bu padmas bskor ba/ dkar gsum gyis sbags pa'i mdun du/ chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo rnams bshams/ bris sku la kha phyogs par khrus dang gtsang sbra la gnas pas stan bde bar 'khod la rdor dril sogs kyang nyer bsdogs bya'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ rang gi chos skyong dang cha gsum gtor ma btang la bar chad mi 'byung bar bka' bsgo/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs kun gyi dngos// bcom ldan 'das ma'i zhabs pad la// bdag dang mkha' mnyam sems can kun// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// lan gsum/ 'gro kun sdug bsngal las bsgral zhing*// bde ba mchog la rab bkod nas// bla med byang chub sar bzhag phyir// sgo gsum dge la bkol bar bya// lan gsum/ mchod pa rnams/ oṃ āḥbighnānta kṛta hūm̐ gis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhrūṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog /bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa mchod pa'i yo byad sna tshogs pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can bskyed nus pa nam mkha'i khams kun nas gang ba kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin phung lta bur gyur/

oṃ badzra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ pā dyaṃ= puṣpe= dhū pe= ā lo ke= gandhe= nai wi dyaṃ= shapad āḥhūm̐/ skad cig gis padma dkar po dang zla ba'i gdan la rang nyid bcom ldan 'das ma yid bzhin 'khor lor gsal ba'i gdan la gnas pa'i taṃ' yig ri bong 'dzin pa lta bu las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad rdo rje'i ra ba dang*/ dra ba dang*/ gur dang*/ bla bre/ mda'i dra ba phyi rol tu ye shes kyi me dpung kun nas 'bar ba'i bsrung ba'i gur khang yangs shing rgya che bar gyur/ oṃ ārya tā re badzra rakṣa hūm̐ bhrūṃ// zhes mchod pa byin rlabs dang srung 'khor gnyis sgrub thabs phal cher la mi 'byung yang*/ spyi mthun yin pas sbyar yang mi 'gal bar sems la/ srung 'khor ni bar chad sel ba'i rten 'brel zab mor gal che ba 'dra'o// slar yang thugs ka'i tāṃ yig las kunda lta bu'i 'od phreng phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams su spros pas/ bcom ldan 'das ma yid bzhin 'khor lo la phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs// rdo rje bsdu ba'i rgyas/ oṃ ārya tā re sa pa ri wā ra badzra sa mā dzaḥ gong gi wā ra'i mthar/ padma ka ma lā ye st+waṃ/ wā ra'i mthar/ arghaṃ nas shapada'i bar gyis mchod/ lha dang lha min cod pan gyis// zhabs kyi padmo la btud de// phongs pa kun las sgrol mdzad ma// sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bstod/ rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma dang*// phyogs bcu dus gsum bzhugs pa yi// rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad la// kun nas dang bas phyag 'tshal lo// me tog bdug spos mar me dri// zhal zas rol mo la sogs pa// dngos 'byor yid kyis sprul nas 'bul// 'phags ma'i tshogs kyis bzhes su gsol// thog ma med nas da lta'i bar// mi dge bcu dang mtshams med lnga// sems ni nyon mongs dbang gyur pa'i// sdig pa thams cad bshags par bgyi// nyan thos rang rgyal byang chub sems// so so skye bo la sogs pas// dus gsum dge ba ci bsags pa// bsod nams la ni bdag yi rang*// sems can rnams kyi bsam pa dang*// blo yi bye brag ji lta ba| |che chung thun mong theg pa yi// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor du gsol// 'khor ba ji srid ma stong bar// mya ngan mi 'da' thugs rje yis// sdug bsngal rgya mtshor byings pa yi// sems can rnams la gzigs su gsol// bdag gis bsod nams ci bsags pa// thams cad byang chub rgyur gyur nas// ring por mi thogs 'gro ba yi// 'dren pa'i dpal du bdag gyur cig

/ces lan gsum gyis tshogs bsags/ tshogs zhing rnams rang gi snying kha'i sa bon la thim par gyur/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig /sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig /sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig /nye ring chags sdang gnyis dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig |lan gsum/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ thugs ka'i tāṃ yig gi 'od kyis bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin pa thams cad 'od gsal stong pa chen po 'byams klas pa'i ngang du sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las byung ba'i padma dkar po 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa mchog tu mdzes shing yangs pa'i ze'u 'bru'i steng du/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya yongs su gang ba 'od zer 'phro ba'i gdan la rang gi rig pa'i ngo bo tāṃ dkar po gnas pa de las kunda lta bu'i 'od zer phyogs thams cad du spros/ 'phags pa'i tshogs ma lus pa mchod/ byin rlabs bsdus te sa bon la bstims/ slar yang 'od zer 'phros pas khams gsum pa'i sems can thams cad kyi dus ma yin pa 'chi ba la sogs pa'i 'jigs pa thams cad bsal/ bcom ldan 'das ma'i go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus sa bon la thim/ yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid tshe dpal bsod nams mtha' dag rab tu 'phel bar byed pa'i bcom ldan 'das ma yid bzhin 'khor lo chu shel gyi lhun po la zla ba'i 'od kyis 'khyud pa lta bur dkar zhing 'tsher la 'od zer kun nas 'phro ba/ utpal lta bur spyan dkyus ring zhing 'dzum pa'i bzhin ras yid du 'ong ba/ dbu skra mthon mthing thor tshugs su bcings pa'i lhag ma g.yas g.yon du 'phyang ba/ lo bcu drug lon pa'i lang tsho nu 'bur zung gis mdzes shing gzhon sha can sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ mtshan dpe'i gzi 'od 'bar ba/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang*/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin sbyar bas utpal dkar po'i yal 'dab rab tu rgyas pa'i yu ba thugs kar 'dzin pa/

kha dog rnam par bkra ba'i lha rdzas kyi sham thabs mnabs shing rin thang gzhal du ma mchis pa'i rin po che sna tshogs pa'i dbu rgyan/ snyan cha/ mgul chu/ se mo do/ do shal/ ska rags/ dpung rgyan/ phyag gdub/ zhabs gdub/ 'og pag la sogs pa rgyan rnam pa du mas mdzes par brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ nya yongs su gang ba'i ri bong 'dzin pa'i rgyab yol mnga' ba/ de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs ka'i cha smad du hūm̐ sngon po/ thugs kar zla ba'i dbus su tām̐ dkar po/ de las 'od zer dkar po glog ltar 'khyug pa spros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i bcom ldan 'das ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba spyan drangs// rdo rje bsdu ba'i rgyas/ oṃ ārya tā re sa pa ri wā ra e hye hi/ badzra sa ma ya dzaḥ oṃ ārya tā re sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ nas/ shapada'i bar gyis mchod/ lha dang lha min sogs kyis bstod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa la ye shes pa thim pas gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis dbang gi lha rgyal ba rigs lnga spyan drangs/ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra badzra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ nas/ shapada'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lhas bum pa dkar po byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin bdud rtsi'i chus gang ba bsnams nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes bum pa'i chu rgyun gyis dbang bskur sku gang*/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sgrib pa sbyangs/ chu lhag ma gyen du 'khyil ba las thor tshugs kyi rtse mor rigs kyi bdag po 'od dpag tu med pa sprul sku'i cha lugs kyis rgyas btab/ dbang gi lha rnams rang nyid la thim par gyur/ oṃ ārya tā re sa pa ri wā ra badzra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/

nas/ shapada'i bar gyis mchod| 'khor ba las sgrol tā re ma/ tuttā ra yis 'jigs brgyad sgrol// tu res nad rnams kun las skyob// sgrol ma la yang phyag 'tshal lo// padma dkar po'i dbus gnas pa// zla ba'i gzugs kyi gdan steng du// rdo rje'i skyil krung bcas mdzad ma// mchog sbyin ma la phyag 'tshal lo// ston zla gsal ba'i mdangs ldan zhing*// zla ba la ni rgyab brten ma// rgyan rnams thams cad yongs su rdzogs// utpal bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bcu drug lo lon lus dang ldan// rdzogs sangs rgyas kun de yi sras// 'dod sbyin sku ni 'chang ba'i yum// 'phags ma sgrol mar phyag 'tshal lo// 'khor lo dkar po 'od zer dkar// rtsibs brgyad la ni yi ge brgyad// yongs su 'khor ba'i rnam pa can// 'khor lo can la phyag 'tshal lo// zhing khams thams cad yongs su dag pa la/ /rin chen me tog mang po gcal du bkram/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad skyed pa'i yum// yum gyur sgrol ma khyod la phyag 'tshal lo| |'phags ma sgrol ma sgrol mdzad yum// yid bzhin 'khor lo tshe 'phel ma// lha mo khyod la gsol ba ni// bdag gi tshe yi bar chad dang*// nad dang sdug bsngal thams cad las| |nus ldan khyod kyis bskyab tu gsol// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub kun// ma lus bdag la stsal du gsol// zhes bstod/ bcom ldan 'das ma'i thugs ka'i dbus su 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad lte ba mu khyud dang bcas pa 'od dkar po 'phro ba'i lte bar tām̐ yig de'i g.yas g.yon du oṃ dang hā'i bar rang ngam bsgrub bya'i ming dang*/ rtsibs brgyad la mdun nas g.yas skor du tā re tuttā re tu re swā' hā zhes pa'i yig 'bru re re rnams rab tu dkar zhing 'od kyi snang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pas phyogs bcu'i zhing thams cad gang bas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong thams cad kyi byin rlabs dang*/

lha dang mi'i 'gro ba thams cad kyi tshe dang bsod nams/ rten snod kyi 'jig rten thams cad kyi rtsi sman rin po che la sogs pa'i nus pa/ 'byung ba chen po bzhi'i bcud thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par bsdus nas thugs ka'i 'khor lo dang yig 'bru la thim pas 'chi ba med pa tshe la dbang ba'i rig pa 'dzin pa'i dngos grub skad cig la thob par gyur// ces dmigs pa la rtse gcig tu gnas pa gzhung gi bstan don dngos dang*/ slar yang 'khor lo de'i phyi mu khyud gsum dang ldan pa'i nang ma la ā di bcu drug /bar ma la kā di so bzhi/ phyi ma la ye dharma rnams g.yas su bskor ba'i yig 'bru rnams dkar po las 'od zer dkar ser dmar mthing ljang mchin kha drug rim par spros pas lus gang*/ phyir 'phros pas bar thag 'dom re tsam nas 'od kyi gur khang kha dog rim pa drug tu gyur pa'i bar mtshams thams cad utpal sngon po gsar du kha bye ma thag pas yongs su gang ba/ 'od kyi kha dog dbye bas zhi rgyas dbang drag gi las sna tshogs thams cad pa de brtan byed kyi nus pa dang ldan par gyur par sgom ba ni/ man ngag mkhyen pa rnams bzhed pas de ltar dmigs pa gong 'og gnyis nan tan du ma yeng bar yun ring bar bsgom/ dmigs pa skyon dang bral bas bzlas pa bya ba ni/ padma'i phreng ba gzhan gyis longs ma spyad pa brgya rtsa brgyad/ gzhon nu mas bkal ba'i skud pa sum sgril la brgyus pa/ ba byung dang dri bzang gi chus bkrus pa bskyil ba thal mo'i bar du snying khar bzung la/ oṃ ba su ma ti shrī ye swā hā/ zhes pa dang*/ oṃ badzra a tsand+ra ye swā hā/ zhes pa gnyis bdun re bzlas pas byin brlabs/ bgrang phreng byin rlabs 'di thun 'go rnams su bya ba yin/ de nas bzla bya'i sngags man ngag gi gnad dang ldan pa ni/ oṃ tā re tuttā re tu re ma ma ā yurdzñā na puṇyai puṣṭiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes bzlas pa'i skyon drug dang bral bar bzla tshul des rab zhag bdun/

'bring nyer gcig /tha mas kyang zla ba gcig gam drug nas mtshan ma mthong la/ grangs kyi bsnyen pa ni/ rtsa ba'i yi ge bcu po sham bu mi the ba 'bru 'bum bzla/ rtags ni/ spyir tshe sgrub gzhan dang mthun la khyad par rmi lam du sātstsha 'am/ mchod rten grangs nges pa can nam/ nges pa med pa gang mthong yang nges par 'chi ba bzlog pa'i rtags su bzhed la/ ma bsgrub kyang bla ma 'di nyid la yi dam du 'dzin pas 'di'i dbang brgya rtsa sogs bgyis pa'i dus sātstsha dang mchod rten mthong ba rmis na/ dus de'i 'chi ba nges par zlog pa ni rang gi myong bas kyang nges par grub pa yin no// thun mthar gtor ma 'bul pa ni/ chu gtsang gis bran la/ bgegs mthar byed kyis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhrūṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ ā hūm̐/ lan gsum gyis byin gyi brlabs/ oṃ ārya tā re sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba lingta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum mam/ bdun nam/ nyer gcig gis phul la/ thal mo sbyar nas/ bcom ldan 'das ma 'khor dang bcas pas mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la mnyes pas bdag cag gi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i sku tshe dang phrin las ches cher rgyas pa dang*/ de la bar du gcod pa'i phyogs thams cad nye bar zhi ba dang*/ mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba sogs 'jigs pa chen po brgyad dang bcu drug las thar zhing*/ nad mtshon mu ge 'khrug pa la sogs pa'i bskal pa mi 'byung bar rdzogs ldan gyi dpal yon lta bu la longs spyod pa dang*/ bdag gi dus ma yin pa 'chi ba la sogs pa'i nyer 'tshe thams cad zhi zhing bsam pa'i don thams cad chos ldan du 'grub pa dang*/

de dag la bar du gcod pa'i nyer 'tshe thams cad mi 'byung zhing tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor thams cad yar ngo'i zla ba ltar 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang*/ mthar thug rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa rgyal ba khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang bde blag tu 'grub pa dang*/ de ma thob kyi bar gyi tshe rabs thams cad du bcom ldan 'das ma khyod nyid lhag pa'i lhar 'dzin cing mi 'bral bar byin gyis rlob cing dngos grub rnam pa gnyis stsol ba'i phrin las thogs pa med pa 'grub par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ mchod cing bstod do/// / ༈ /gnyis pa kha skong rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg ni/ gnas khang gi yangs dog dang bstun pa'i stegs bu rgya dpangs 'tsham pa| ba byung dang dri bzang byugs pa'i steng du thig chen brgyad btab par rgyas pa'i thab khung rgyar khru do'am gang pa/ rgya'i brgyad cha'i mchu dang kha khyer pad rar bcas pa/ nang du 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar rin po che rdo rjes mtshan pa/ kha khyer la rin po che dang pad ra/ phyogs rer 'dab ma bzhi re rnams rdul tshon ser pos bris pa'i kha khyer gyi steng du/ thab kyi rgya'i phyed dang mnyam pa'i bud shing 'bras bu can rlan dang srog chags med pa brtsigs/ grwa bzhir rin po che ser po re re bri/ rang gi g.yas ngos su 'bras bu can gyi rked pa'i cha las byung ba'i khu tshur bcangs pa'i khru gang ngam sor mo bcu gnyis/ sbom phra lag ngar phra ba tsam mam mthe bong tsam pa/ dri ser po dang*/ zho dang*/ 'o ma dang*/ mar dkar gyis sbags pa mngar gsum gyis bran pa dang*| mar dkar gyi mar khu dri ser pos sbags pa durba'i myu gu sngon po 'o ma dang*/ zho dang*/ sbrang rtsi dang*/ mar la bsnyugs pa dang*/ 'bras chan zho dang bsres pa mngar gsum gyis sbags pa'i zas mchog /zho sbrang rtsi til nag zhun mar dang bcas pas sbags pa'i 'bras ma grug pa la padma ge sar dang*/

nā ga ge sar dang*/ shing tog sna tshogs bsres pa rnams bshams/ g.yon du chu bzhi bzed zhal dang bcas pa/ mdun du dgang blugs/ rdor dril/ nyer spyod lnga/ gtor ma/ gos zung*/ las thams cad pas sngags pa'i bsang chu rnams bshams/ khrus bya/ gos dang rgyan phreng ser po bgo/ bzang po'i 'dug stangs kyis byang du kha phyogs pas bdag gi rnal 'byor sngar ltar bsgoms/ mchod rdzas rnams bsangs sbyangs/ rang sngags dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs/ me shel las byung ba'am/ dge 'dun gyi tshang mang gi mes sbar ba'i dpal 'bar ku sha dang lhan cig bsangs/ yi ge bcu pa'i sngags kyis me sbar/ oṃ dzwa la dzwa la hūm̐/ zhes rlung g.yab kyis g.yab/ oṃ agna ye swā hā/ zhes mar khu dgang blugs gsum gyis me gso/ oṃ badzra satwa āḥ zhes g.yas skor du ku sha bkram/ thab bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las ye shes kyi thab khung ser po gru bzhi pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du raṃ las ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus su pad nyi'i gdan la raṃ dang bgrang phreng las skyes pa'i me lha gser btso ma lta bu tshim zhing rangs pa'i nyams can sha rgyas shing gsus pa 'phyang ba ral pa'i thor tshugs can phyag g.yas mchog sbyin gyis ril ba spyi blugs dang*/ g.yon thugs kar skyabs sbyin gyis bgrang phreng 'dzin pa/ gos rgyan ser po can g.yon brkyang gis gnas pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur/ ṭa ki hūm̐ dzaḥ rang gi thugs ka'i tāṃ yig gi 'od kyis shar lho nas me lha ye shes pa spyan drangs/ phyir 'brang gi bgegs thams cad las sngags kyis bskrad/ mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ me lha ye shes pa dam tshig pa la thim pas gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs pa nas/ dbang lha rnams rang nyid la thim par gyur gyi bar bdag bskyed ltar sbyar/

oṃ agna ye badzra sa ma ya hūm̐ gis dam la bzhag |me pra brtag /ngan na bzlog thabs bya/ chu bzhi nyer spyod rol mos mchod/ oṃ na maḥs manta buddhā nāṃ oṃ agna ye swā hās dgang blugs bdun phul/ mchod pa bdag bskyed ltar la chu bzhi sbyar bas byin brlabs/ oṃ swā hās rdzas rnams bkrus/ oṃ āḥswā hās yam shing*/ oṃ shrīṃ swā hās zhun mar/ oṃ dzriṃ swā hās 'bras bu/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swā hās rdzas gzhan rnams sbyangs/ slar rdzas rang rang gi sngags lan gsum res byin gyis brlab pa ni/ yam shing zung du sbyar la/ oṃ badzra ya dzñā ya swā hā/ zhun mar la/ na maḥs manta sogs gong ltar/ dūrba la/ oṃ badzra a yu ṣe swā hā/ zas mchog la/ oṃ sarba sampa de swā hā/ 'bras la/ oṃ badzra puṣṭa ye swā hā/ zhes nyer gcig re sogs 'bul/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras// me lha'i rgyal po ṭa kis dbang bskur bas// shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad bsregs/ */ dbang chen me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud// ces bstod/ me lha'i thugs kar paṃ las byung ba'i padma dkar po 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa mchog tu mdzes nas/ dbang gi lha rnams rang nyid la thim par gyur gyi bar bdag bskyed ltar la/ rang gi rig pa'i ngo bo dang rang nyid ces sogs dor/ mdun bskyed la maṇḍal gyi skabs ltar mchod pa la chu bzhi sbyar ba dang bstod/ bcom ldan 'das ma zhal cung zad gdangs pa'i ljags la raṃ yig dang dgang blugs kyi khar tāṃ yig ser pos mtshan par/ zhes dang*/ oṃ tā re tuttā re tu re na maḥs manta buddhā nāṃ agna ye bdag gi tshe bsod puṣṭiṃ ku ru oṃ| zhes dgang blugs gsum mam/ lnga bdun sogs 'bul/ yam shing la/ oṃ ārya tā re badzra ya dzñā ye bdag gi tshe dang gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa puṣṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ de ltar thog mtha' so sor sbyar bas mar khu la/ agna ye bdag gi tshe dang 'byor pa phun sum tshogs pa puṣṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/

dūrba la/ badzra a yu ṣe bdag gi tshe dang gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa puṣṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ zas mchog la/ oṃ badzra sampa de bdag gi tshe dang bde ba mchog gi gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa puṣṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ 'bras la/ badzra puṣṭa ye bdag gi tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor pa phun sum tshogs pa puṣṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ zhes sbyar ba brgya phrag sogs 'bul zhing*/ khyad par durba'i sngags bcas grangs ci mang 'bul ba gal che/ de rjes/ srab 'jam yang pa lha yi gos// mi shig rdo rje'i sku nyid la// mi phyed dad pas bdag 'bul gyi// bdag kyang rdo rje'i sku thob shog /ces gos zung phul/ thun mtshams ltar gtor ma dbul/ 'dod gsol bya/ oṃ arya tā re sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya sogs kyis lhag chad bskangs/ oṃ badzra muḥ bcom ldan 'das ma ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/ oṃ agna ye swā hās dgang blugs gsum me lhar dbul/ rdzas gzhan rnams rang rang gi sngags kyis lan gsum re dbul/ gtor ma/ a kā ros byin brlabs la/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la/ */nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod kyi bar brjod/ oṃ badzra wast+ra ya hūm̐ gis gos zung phul/ yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskangs/ badzra muḥ ye shes pa rang gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa me 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur par bsam/ a kā ro'i sngags brjod/ shis brjod bya/ me rang zhir btang*/ thal sol rnams rgyun 'bab kyi chu bor dor ro/// / ༈ /gsum pa sgrub cing mchod pa'i rim pa ni/ gnas khang rgyan dang ldan par maṇḍal la dri bzang byugs par gling dgur dbye ba'i dbus gling dang*/ mtshams bzhi'i gling du/ sna tshogs padma 'dab brgyad re re/ phyogs gling bzhir ri rab gling bzhi gling phran dang bcas re re bri/ dbus gling du khri'i steng du bcom ldan 'das ma'i sku rab gnas dang ldan pa zhal rang la phyogs pa bzhugs su gsol/ mtshams gling bzhir nyer spyod tshar re re/

phyogs gling bzhir rin po che'i snod me tog gis bkang ba re re bkod/ de'i mthar mchod pa rnam pa sna tshogs pa dang gtor ma bcas legs par bshams/ bdag gi rnal 'byor rdzogs par bsgoms nas mdun gyi sku la dmigs te bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las byung ba'i padma dkar po 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa mchog tu mdzes shing yangs pa'i ze'u 'bru'i steng du/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya yongs su gang ba 'od zer 'phro ba'i gdan la tāṃ dkar po gnas pa de las kunda lta bu'i 'od zer phyogs thams cad du spros/ 'phags pa'i tshogs ma lus pa mchod/ byin rlabs bsdus te sa bon la bstims/ slar yang 'od zer 'phros pas khams gsum pa'i sems can thams cad kyi dus ma yin pa 'chi ba la sogs pa'i 'jigs pa thams cad bsal/ bcom ldan 'das ma'i go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus sa bon la thim/ yongs su gyur pa las/ tshe dpal bsod nams mtha' dag rab tu 'phel bar byed pa'i bcom ldan 'das ma yid bzhin 'khor lo chu shel gyi lhun po la zla ba'i 'od kyis 'khyud pa lta bur dkar zhing 'tsher la 'od zer kun nas 'phro ba/ utpal lta bur spyan dkyus ring zhing 'dzum pa'i bzhin ras yid du 'ong ba/ dbu skra mthon mthing thor tshugs su bcings pa'i lhag ma g.yas g.yon du 'phyang ba/ lo bcu drug lon pa'i lang tsho nu 'bur zung gis mdzes shing gzhon sha can sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ mtshan dpe'i gzi 'od 'bar ba/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang*/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin sbyar bas utpal dkar po'i yal 'dab rab tu rgyas pa'i yu ba thugs kar 'dzin pa/ kha dog rnam par bkra ba'i lha rdzas kyi sham thabs mnabs shing rin thang gzhal du ma mchis pa'i rin po che sna tshogs pa'i dbu rgyan/ snyan cha/ mgul chu/ se mo do/ do shal/ ska rags/ dpung rgyan/ phyag gdub/ zhabs gdub/ 'og pag la sogs pa rgyan rnam pa du mas mdzes par brgyan pa/

zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ nya yongs su gang ba'i ri bong 'dzin pa'i rgyab yol mnga' ba/ de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs ka'i cha smad du hūm̐ sngon po/ thugs kar zla ba'i dbus su tāṃ dkar po/ de las 'od zer dkar po glog ltar 'khyug pa spros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i bcom ldan 'das ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba spyan drangs/ spos dang rdor dril thogs pa rdo rje bsdu ba'i rgyas/ oṃ ārya tā re sa pa ri wā ra badzra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ/ thugs rje rmad byung bcom ldan 'das// 'jig rten dbang po'i sras mo mchog /ma lus rgyal ba kun gyi yum// 'phags ma sgrol ma 'dir gshegs shig /oṃ hye hi/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa la ye shes pa thim pas gnyis su med par gyur/ lha klu lha min dbang po sogs// bye ba'i gtsug gis rab btud pa'i// gdan khri mchog tu mdzes pa 'dir// dgyes ldan rtag par bzhugs su gsol// oṃ ārya tā re sa pa ri wā ra padma ka ma lā ye st+waṃ/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis dbang gi lha rgyal ba rigs lnga spyan drangs/ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra badzra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ nas/ shapada'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lhas bum pa dkar po byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin bdud rtsi'i chus gang ba bsnams nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes bum pa'i chu rgyun gyis dbang bskur sku gang*| bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sgrib pa sbyangs/ chu lhag ma gyen du 'khyil ba las thor tshugs kyi rtse mor rigs kyi bdag po 'od dpag med pa sprul sku'i cha lugs kyi rgyas btab| dbang gi lha rnams kyang bcom ldan 'das ma de nyid la thim par gyur/

ces dang*/ oṃ/ dus gsum rgyal ba ma lus kun gyi yum// khams gsum 'gro ba kun gyi gnyen gcig pu| |dus gsum bla ma mchog gi ngo bo nyid// rigs gsum 'phags ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// oṃ arya tā re sa pa ri wā ra na mo na maḥ zhes phyag 'tshal/ phyi nang gsang ba de kho na'i| |mchod yon mchod pa rgya mtsho'i sprin// chos dbyings kun tu rgyas 'gengs pa// rgyal ba'i yum la mchod pa 'bul// oṃ ārya tā re sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ de bzhin du/ zhabs bsil/ pā dyaṃ/ me tog /puṣpe/ bdug spos/ dhū pe/ snang gsal/ ā lo ke/ dri chab/ gandhe/ zhal zas/ nai wi dyaṃ/ rol mo/ shapad| gzugs mchog /rū pa/ sgra snyan/ shapad/ dri mchog /gandhe/ ro mchog /ra sa/ na bza'/ sparshe/ chos mchog /dharma dhā tu/ zhes sogs sbyar bas mchod/ 'khor lo la sogs rgyal srid rin chen bdun// gnas khang la sogs nye ba'i rin chen dang*/ bkra shis gdugs sogs bkra shis rtags brgyad dang*// me long la sogs bkra shis rdzas brgyad sogs/ */stong gsum kun gyi 'dod pa'i yon tan tshogs/ */bdag pos bzung dang ma bzung ji snyed kun// bdag blos blangs te rgyal yum nyid la 'bul// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol// oṃ ārya tā re sa pa ri wā ra maṅga laṃ ratna sapta aṣṭa pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ oṃ badzra bhū mi āḥhūm̐/ gzhi rnam par dag pa dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi sogs nas/ zhing khams rnam par dag pa 'di nyid bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyi don du bcom ldan 'das ma yid bzhin 'khor lor 'khor sangs rgyas dang byang sems bla ma yi dam dpa' po mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la 'bul bar bgyi'o/ */thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol|

sa gzhi spos byugs sogs dang*/ mnyes phyir maṇḍal bzang po sogs dang*/ sku gsum yongs rdzogs 'phags ma'i tshogs rnams la// phyi nang gsang gsum de bzhin nyid sogs dang*/ phyag 'tshal ba dang zhes sogs yan lag bdun pa rgyas bsdus long skabs dang sbyar bas 'bul/ slar yang*/ rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma dang*// phyogs bcu dus gsum bzhugs pa yi// rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad la// kun nas dang bas phyag 'tshal lo// me tog bdug spos mar me dri// zhal zas rol mo la sogs pa// dngos 'byor yid kyis sprul nas 'bul// 'phags ma'i tshogs kyis bzhes su gsol// thog ma med nas da lta'i bar// mi dge bcu dang mtshams med lnga// sems ni nyon mongs dbang gyur pa'i// sdig pa thams cad bshags par bgyi// nyan thos rang rgyal byang chub sems// so so skye bo la sogs pas// dus gsum dge ba ci bsags pa'i// bsod nams la ni bdag yi rang*// sems can rnams kyi bsam pa dang*// blo yi bye brag ji lta bar// che chung thun mong theg pa yi// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor du gsol// 'khor ba ji srid ma stong bar// mya ngan mi 'da' thugs rje yis// sdug bsngal rgya mtshor bying ba yi| |sems can rnams la gzigs su gsol// bdag gis bsod nams ci bsags pa// thams cad byang chub rgyur gyur nas// ring por mi thogs 'gro ba yi// 'dren pa'i dpal du bdag gyur cig /ces bdun rnam dag bya/ sgrub thabs kyi thun mtshams ltar gtor ma 'bul/ gsol ba btab/ rdor dril 'dzin pas// oṃ rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo| |phyag 'tshal sgrol ma myur ma dpa' mo// spyan ni skad cig glog dang 'dra ma// 'jig rten gsum mgon chu skyes zhal gyi// ge sar bye ba las ni byung ma// phyag 'tshal ston ka'i zla ba kun tu// gang ba brgya ni brtsegs pa'i zhal ma// skar ma stong phrag tshogs pa rnams kyis// rab tu phye ba'i 'od rab 'bar ma// phyag 'tshal ser sngo chu nas skyes kyi// padmas phyag ni rnam par brgyan ma// sbyin pa brtson 'grus dka' thub zhi ba// bzod pa bsam gtan spyod yul nyid ma// phyag 'tshal de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor// mtha' yas rnam par rgyal bar spyod ma// ma lus pha rol phyin pa thob pa'i// rgyal ba'i sras kyis shin tu bsten ma// phyag 'tshal tuttā ra hūm̐ yi ges// 'dod dang phyogs dang nam mkha' gang ma// 'jig rten bdun po zhabs kyis mnan te/

/lus pa med par 'gugs par nus ma/ /phyag 'tshal brgya byin me lha tshangs pa// rlung lha sna tshogs dbang phyug mchod ma// 'byung po ro langs dri za rnams dang*| |gnod sbyin tshogs kyis mdun nas bstod ma// phyag 'tshal traṭa ces bya dang phaṭa kyis// pha rol 'khrul 'khor rab tu 'joms ma// g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang zhabs kyis mnan te| |me 'bar 'khrug pa shin tu 'bar ma// phyag 'tshal tu re 'jigs pa chen mos// bdud kyi dpa' bo rnam par 'joms ma// chu skyes zhal ni khro gnyer ldan mdzad// dgra bo thams cad ma lus gsod ma// phyag 'tshal dkon mchog gsum mtshon phyag rgya'i// sor mos thugs kar rnam par brgyan ma// ma lus phyogs kyi 'khor los brgyan pa'i// rang gi 'od kyis tshogs rnams 'khrug ma// phyag 'tshal rab tu dga' ba brjid pa'i// dbu rgyan 'od kyi phreng ba spel ma// bzhad pa rab bzhad tuttā ra yis// bdud dang 'jig rten dbang du mdzad ma// phyag 'tshal sa gzhi skyong ba'i tshogs rnams// thams cad 'gugs par nus pa nyid ma/ khro gnyer g.yo ba'i yi ge hūm̐ gis// phongs pa thams cad rnam par sgrol ma// phyag 'tshal zla ba'i dum bus dbu brgyan// brgyan pa thams cad shin tu 'bar ma// ral pa'i khrod na 'od dpag med las// rtag par shin tu 'od rab mdzad ma// phyag 'tshal bskal pa tha ma'i me ltar// 'bar ba'i phreng ba'i dbus na gnas ma// g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum kun nas bskor dga'// dgra yi dpung ni rnam par 'joms ma// phyag 'tshal sa gzhi'i ngos la phyag gi// mthil gyis bsnun cing zhabs kyis rdung ma/ khro gnyer can mdzad yi ge hūm̐ gis// rim pa bdun po rnams ni 'gems ma// phyag 'tshal bde ma dge ma zhi ma// mya ngan 'das zhi spyod yul nyid ma// swā hā oṃ dang yang dag ldan pas// sdig pa chen po 'joms pa nyid ma// phyag 'tshal kun nas bskor rab dga' ba'i// dgra yi lus ni rab tu 'gems ma| |yi ge bcu pa'i ngag ni bkod pa'i// rig pa hūm̐ las sgrol ma nyid ma// phyag 'tshal tu re'i zhabs ni brdabs pas// hūm̐ gi rnam pa'i sa bon nyid ma// ri rab mandha ra dang 'bigs byed| |'jig rten gsum rnams g.yo ba nyid ma// phyag 'tshal lha yi mtsho yi rnam pa'i// ri dwags rtags can phyag na bsnams ma// tā re gnyis brjod phaṭa kyi yi ges// dug rnams ma lus pa ni sel ma// phyag 'tshal lha yi tshogs rnams rgyal po// lha dang mi 'am ci yis bsten ma// kun nas go cha dga' ba'i brjid kyis// rtsod dang rmi lam ngan pa sel ma// phyag 'tshal nyi ma zla ba rgyas pa'i// spyan gnyis po las 'od rab gsal ma// ha ra gnyis brjod tuttā ra yis// shin tu drag po'i rims nad sel ma// phyag 'tshal de nyid gsum rnams bkod pas| |zhi ba'i mthu dang yang dag ldan ma// gdon dang ro langs gnod sbyin tshogs rnams// 'joms pa tu re rab mchog nyid ma// rtsa ba'i sngags kyi bstod pa 'di dang*// phyag 'tshal ba ni nyi shu rtsa gcig

/ces pa'i phyag 'tshal zhes pa'i skabs thal sbyar dril bu gsil/ slar thal mo sbyar la/ rje btsun bcom ldan 'das ma thugs rje can// bdag dang mtha' yas sems can thams cad kyi// sgrib gnyis byang zhing tshogs gnyis myur rdzogs te// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par mdzad du gsol// de ma thob kyi tshe rabs kun tu yang*// lha dang mi yi bde ba'i mchog thob nas// thams cad mkhyen pa sgrub par byed pa la// bar chad gdon bgegs rims dang nad la sogs// dus min 'chi bar gyur pa sna tshogs dang*// rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan pa dang*// 'jigs pa brgyad sogs nye bar 'tshe ba rnams/ /myur du zhi zhing med par mdzad du gsol/ /'jig rten 'jig rten las ni 'das pa yi// bkra shis bde legs phun sum tshogs pa rnams// 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i don rnams ma lus pa// 'bad med lhun gyis 'grub par mdzad du gsol// sgrub la brtson cing dam chos 'phel ba dang*// rtag tu khyod sgrub zhal mchog mthong ba dang*// stong nyid don rtogs byang sems rin po che// yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzod// rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor bzang zhing dga' ba der| |padmo dam pa shin tu mdzes las skyes// snang ba mtha' yas rgyal bas mngon sum du// lung bstan pa yang bdag gis der thob shog /bdag gis tshe rabs kun tu bsgrubs pa'i lha| |dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi phrin las ma// sngo ljang zhal gcig phyag gnyis myur zhi ma// yum gyur utpal bsnams pa'i bkra shis shog /rgyal yum sgrol ma khyed sku ci 'dra dang*| |'khor dang sku tshe'i tshad dang zhing khams dang*/ khyed kyi mtshan mchog bzang po ci 'dra ba// de 'dra kho nar bdag sogs 'gyur bar shog /khyod la bstod cing gsol ba btab pa'i mthus| |bdag sogs gang du gnas pa'i sa phyogs su// nad gdon dbul phongs 'thab rtsod zhi ba dang*// chos dang bkra shis 'phel bar mdzad du gsol// sku yi skyon spangs mtshan dang dpe byad ldan/

/gsung gi skyon spangs ka la piṅka'i dbyangs/ /thugs kyi skyon spangs shes bya mtha' dag gzigs/ /bkra shis dpal 'bar ma yi bkra shis shog /ces gsol ba btab/ 'phags ma'i thugs kar ri bong 'dzin pa'i dkyil 'khor nya yongs su gang ba'i dbus su tāṃ yig dkar po'i mthar sngags phreng gis bskor ba las 'od 'phros don gnyis byas| slar 'dus bdag la phog pas tshe bsod dpal 'byor thams cad rgyas par gyur par dmigs la/ oṃ tā re tuttā re tu re ma ma āyurdzñā na puṇyai puṣṭiṃ ku ru swā hā/ ci 'grub bzla'o/ /slar thal mo snying gar sbyar la/ ma skye ba med pa'i chos dbyings na/ /yum rje btsun lha mo sgrol ma bzhugs/ /de sems can kun la bde ster ma/ /bdag 'jigs pa kun las bskyab tu gsol| |rang chos sku yin par ma shes par// sems nyon mongs dbang du gyur pa yi// ma 'khor ba 'khyams pa'i sems can la// yum lha mo khyod kyis bskyab tu gsol// chos snying nas rgyud la ma skyes par/ /tha snyad tshig gi rjes 'brangs nas/ /grub mtha' ngan pas bslus pa la/ /yum yang dag gi lha mos bskyab tu gsol/ /rtogs par dka' ba rang gi sems// mthong nas goms par mi byed par// bya ba ngan pas g.yengs pa la// yum dran pa'i lha mos bskyab tu gsol// sems rang byung gnyis med ye shes la// gnyis su 'dzin pa'i bag chags kyis// ji ltar byas kyang bcings pa rnams// thugs gnyis med kyi lha mos bskyab tu gsol// yang dag gi don la gnas byas kyang*| |rgyu 'bras kyi rten 'brel mi shes pas// shes bya'i don la rmongs pa la// yum kun mkhyen gyi lha mos bskyab tu gsol// spros bral nam mkha'i mtshan nyid can// thams cad de dang dbyer med kyis// da dung slob pa'i gang zag la// yum rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis bskyab tu gsol// zhes pa e chung du rje 'jig rten mgon pos 'phags ma sgrol ma bdun zhal gzigs dus gsol ba btab par skyabs bdun mar grags pa/

byin rlabs shin tu che bar grags pas gsol ba btab bo/// / ༈ /gnyis pa gzhan don du sgrub pa la gnyis/ slob dpon gyi bya ba dang*/ slob ma'i bya ba'o// dang po ni/ gnas yid dang mthun par bris sku'i mdun du bshad ma thag pa lta bu'i maṇḍal lam/ de ltar ma grub na rdul tshon dkar po'i padma 'dab brgyad lte ba ge sar mu khyud dang bcas pa'i lte bar/ 'bru dkar po'i tshom bu gcig bkod/ de'i gzhogs g.yas su rin po che'i bum pa dkar po lha rdzas dkar pos dkris shing 'bras can gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa'i nang du/ rta glang gis ma bgrod pa'i rgyun 'bab kyi chu dang 'o ma bsres pa la lnga tshan lnga'i rdzas kyis sbags pas sum gnyis bkang*/ kha rgyan gyi gseb tu dung zhal dri chus bkang ba'i steng du rdo rje la me tog gi phreng ba btags pa bzhag /mchod gtor sogs gang dgos pa bshams/ bdag mdun mchod bstod gong ltar/ bum pa bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhrūm̐ las byung ba'i bum pa gzhal yas khang gi rnam par gyur pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po'i dbus su/ paṃ las padma dkar po 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa mchog tu mdzes shing yangs pa'i ze'u 'bru'i steng du/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya yongs su gang ba 'od zer 'phro ba'i gdan la tāṃ dkar po gnas pa de las kunda lta bu'i 'od zer phyogs thams cad du spros/ 'phags pa'i tshogs ma lus pa mchod/ byin rlabs bsdus te sa bon la bstims/ slar yang 'od zer 'phros pas khams gsum pa'i sems can thams cad kyi dus ma yin pa 'chi ba la sogs pa'i 'jigs pa thams cad bsal/ bcom ldan 'das ma'i go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus sa bon la thim/ yongs su gyur pa las/ tshe dpal bsod nams mtha' dag rab tu 'phel bar byed pa'i bcom ldan 'das ma yid bzhin 'khor lo chu shel gyi lhun po la zla ba'i 'od kyis 'khyud pa lta bur dkar zhing 'tsher la 'od zer kun nas 'phro ba/

utpal lta bur spyan dkyus ring zhing 'dzum pa'i bzhin ras yid du 'ong ba/ dbu skra mthon mthing thor tshugs su bcings pa'i lhag ma g.yas g.yon du 'phyang ba/ lo bcu drug lon pa'i lang tsho nu 'bur zung gis mdzes shing gzhon sha can sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ mtshan dpe'i gzi 'od 'bar ba/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang*/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin sbyar bas utpal dkar po'i yal 'dab rab tu rgyas pa'i yu ba thugs kar 'dzin pa/ kha dog rnam par bkra ba'i lha rdzas kyi sham thabs mnabs shing rin thang gzhal du ma mchis pa'i rin po che sna tshogs pa'i dbu rgyan/ snyan cha/ mgul chu/ se mo do/ do shal/ ska rags/ dpung rgyan/ phyag gdub/ zhabs gdub/ 'og pag la sogs pa rgyan rnam pa du mas mdzes par brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ nya yongs su gang ba'i ri bong 'dzin pa'i rgyab yol mnga' ba/ de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs ka'i cha smad du hūm̐ sngon po/ thugs kar zla ba'i dbus su tāṃ dkar po/ de las 'od zer dkar po glog ltar 'khyug pa spros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i bcom ldan 'das ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba spyan drangs/ spos dang rdor dril thogs pa rdo rje bsdu ba'i rgyas/ oṃ ārya tā re sa pa ri wā ra badzra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ/ thugs rje rmad byung bcom ldan 'das// 'jig rten dbang po'i sras mo mchog |ma lus rgyal ba kun gyi yum// 'phags ma sgrol ma 'dir gshegs shig /oṃ hye hi/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa la ye shes pa thim pas gnyis su med par gyur// lha klu lha min dbang po sogs// bye ba'i gtsug gis rab btud pa'i// gdan khri mchog tu mdzes pa 'dir// dgyes ldan rtag par bzhugs su gsol// oṃ ārya tā re sa pa ri wā ra padma ka ma lā ye st+waṃ/

slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis dbang gi lha rgyal ba rigs lnga spyan drangs/ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra badzra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ nas/ shapada'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lhas bum pa dkar po byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin bdud rtsi'i chus gang ba bsnams nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes bum pa'i chu rgyun gyis dbang bskur sku gang*/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sgrib pa sbyangs/ chu lhag ma gyen du 'khyil ba las thor tshugs kyi rtse mor rigs kyi bdag po 'od dpag med pa sprul sku'i cha lugs kyi rgyas btab/ dbang gi lha rnams kyang bcom ldan 'das ma de nyid la thim par gyur/ mchod pa byin rlabs ni/ oṃ āḥbighnānta kṛta hūm̐ gis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhrūṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog /bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa mchod pa'i yo byad sna tshogs pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can bskyed nus pa nam mkha'i khams kun nas gang ba kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin phung lta bur gyur/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ pā dyaṃ= puṣpe= dhū pe= ā lo ke= gandhe= nai wi dyaṃ= shapad āḥhūm̐/ phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i zhing khams su// lha rdzas las grub mchod yon tshogs// bcom ldan bum pa'i lha la 'bul// dbang dang dngos grub stsal du gsol// oṃ ārya tā re sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ nas/ shapada'i bar gyis mchod/ rdor dril dang bcas pas/ glog dang 'dra ba'i spyan mnga' ma// dpa' mo tā re tuttā re// sangs rgyas zhal gyi padmo yi// ge sar las byung khyod la bstod// 'khor lo'i gzeb las tuttā re// swā hās nyon mongs zhi bar mdzad// oṃ gyi ngo bo nyid kyis ni// tshangs pa'i sgo 'byed ma la 'dud| |'jigs pa chen po brgyad rnams las// 'jig rten thams cad skyob par mdzad// kun gyi mar gyur bcom ldan 'das// sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces bstod/

gzung thag nas 'jus la/ bcom ldan 'das ma'i thugs kar yid bzhin 'khor lor gsal ba'i 'od kyis brtan g.yo ma lus pa'i tshe bsod dpal 'byor thams cad bsdus/ bcom ldan 'das ma la thim/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las sngags phreng spros/ gzung thag la brgyud de song bum nang gi 'phags ma'i thugs ka'i 'khor lo la thim pas bcom ldan 'das ma'i sku dang 'khor lo las bdud rtsi bab pas bum pa gang bar gyur/ oṃ tā re tuttā re tu re ma ma ā yurdzñā na puṇyai puṣṭiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags brgya phrag bzla/ slar/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ zhes dung zhal gyi chu bum pa'i lha la mchod yon du phul bas/ bcom ldan 'das ma'i thugs ka'i 'khor lo dang bcas pa bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du zhu ba bum chu dang dbyer med du 'dres par gyur/ zhes dmigs nas sngags ci 'grub bzla/ dung zhal du dri'i chu ku sha dang bcas pas/ oṃ āḥbighnānta kṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces sngags ci 'grub kyang bzla/ bum mdun gyi lha la thun mtshams su gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ chu gtsang gis bran la/ bgegs mthar byed kyis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhrūṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ ā hūm̐/ lan gsum gyis byin gyi brlabs/ oṃ ārya tā re sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba lingta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum mam/ bdun nam/ nyer gcig gis phul la/ thal mo sbyar nas/ bcom ldan 'das ma 'khor dang bcas pas mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la mnyes pas bdag cag gi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i sku tshe dang phrin las ches cher rgyas pa dang*/ de la bar du gcod pa'i phyogs thams cad nye bar zhi ba dang*/

mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba sogs 'jigs pa chen po brgyad dang bcu drug las thar zhing*/ nad mtshon mu ge 'khrug pa la sogs pa'i bskal pa mi 'byung bar rdzogs ldan gyi dpal yon lta bu la longs spyod pa dang*/ bdag gi dus ma yin pa 'chi ba la sogs pa'i nyer 'tshe thams cad zhi zhing bsam pa'i don thams cad chos ldan du 'grub pa dang*/ de dag la bar du gcod pa'i nyer 'tshe thams cad mi 'byung zhing tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor thams cad yar do'i zla ba ltar 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang*/ mthar thug rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa rgyal ba khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang bde blag tu 'grub pa dang*/ de ma thob kyi bar gyi tshe rabs thams cad du bcom ldan 'das ma khyod nyid lhag pa'i lhar 'dzin cing mi 'bral bar byin gyis rlob cing dngos grub rnam pa gnyis stsol ba'i phrin las thogs pa med pa 'grub par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab nas/ sngags tsam la brten nas bdag 'jug blang ngo*/// / ༈ /gnyis pa slob ma'i bya ba ni/ phyag dang yon dbul/ maṇḍal phul la/ pus btsug thal mo sbyar nas/ lha dang lha min cod pan gyis// zhabs kyi padmo la btud de// phongs pa kun las sgrol mdzad ma// sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo// 'phags ma sgrol ma sgrol mdzad yum// yid bzhin 'khor lo tshe 'phel ma// lha mo khyod la gsol ba ni// bdag gi tshe yi bar chad dang*| |nad dang sdug bsngal thams cad las// nus ldan khyod kyis bskyab tu gsol// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub kun// ma lus bdag la gnang bar mdzod// ces gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bcom ldan 'das ma yid bzhin 'khor lo la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor nas bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar mos pa drag po dang bcas pas yan lag bdun pa 'bul ba ni/ rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma dang*// phyogs bcu dus gsum bzhugs pa yi// rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad la// kun nas dang bas phyag 'tshal lo// me tog bdug spos mar me dri// zhal zas rol mo la sogs pa// dngos 'byor yid kyis sprul nas 'bul// 'phags ma'i tshogs kyis bzhes su gsol// thog ma med nas da lta'i bar// mi dge bcu dang mtshams med lnga// sems ni nyon mongs dbang gyur pa'i// sdig pa thams cad bshags par bgyi// nyan thos rang rgyal byang chub sems//

so so skye bo la sogs pas// dus gsum dge ba ci bsags pa'i// bsod nams la ni bdag yi rang*// sems can rnams kyi bsam pa dang*// blo yi bye brag ji lta bar// che chung thun mong theg pa yi// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor du gsol// 'khor ba ji srid ma stong bar// mya ngan mi 'da' thugs rje yis// sdug bsngal rgya mtshor bying ba yi// sems can rnams la gzigs su gsol// bdag gis bsod nams ci bsags pa// thams cad byang chub rgyur gyur nas// ring por mi thogs 'gro ba yi// 'dren pa'i dpal du bdag gyur cig /ces pa'i bar gsum bya/ slob ma bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dkar po 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa mchog tu mdzes pa zhes pa nas rgyab yol mnga' ba'i bar bdag bskyed ltar rang gi zhes pa dang rang nyid ces pa'i mal du khyed rang zhes bsgyur/ slar yang de ltar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i dbus su 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad lte ba mu khyud dang bcas pa 'od dkar po 'phro ba'i zhes ba nas rab tu dkar zhing 'od kyi snang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pas phyogs bcu'i zhing khams gang bar gyur par dmigs la/ bla ma yid bzhin 'khor lo dngos su gsal ba la/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma rin po ches bdag gi dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa thams cad bsal nas bcom ldan 'das ma'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ lan gsum gsol ba btab/ slob dpon yid bzhin 'khor lo dngos su gsal ba'i thugs ka'i 'khor lo'i sngags dang bcas pa las 'od zer dkar po glog dang 'dra ba phyogs bcur 'phros pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ de rnams kyi thugs dang gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi 'khor lo dkar po yig 'bru dang bcas pa'i rnam par zla ba nya gang ba ltar byon pa slob dpon gyi thugs kar thim/

slar yang slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i 'khor lo sngags dang bcas pa las mar me gcig las gnyis pa mched pa ltar 'khor lo sngags dang bcas pa dpag tu med pa byon/ slob ma lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i 'khor lo sngags dang bcas pa la sib sib rim pa ltar thim pas bcom ldan 'das ma dang sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa zhugs/ yig 'bru'i 'od kyis lus thams cad gang bas thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nad gdon dus ma yin par 'chi ba la sogs pa'i bar gcod thams cad bsal 'chi ba med pa tshe'i dngos grub dam pa thob pa dpon slob gnyis kas bsam/ spos sreg rol mo dang bcas pas/ oṃ ārya tā re sa pa ri wā ra ā we sha ya badzra sa mā dzaḥdzaḥdzaḥ zhes dbab/ brtan byed chu dbang gi don du slob mas/ byang chub rdo rjes gsol ba btab/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis dbang gi lha bcom ldan 'das ma yid bzhin 'khor lo la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pas bskor ba spyan drangs/ oṃ ārya tā re sarba ta thā ga ta badzra puṣpaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ sogs nyer spyod lngas mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di rnams la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes slob dpon gyis gsol ba btab pas/ bum pa dkar po byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsis bkang ba slob ma'i steng du cung zad yo bar bzung ste/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyis// skye nas thob pa'i dbang bskur bas// ji ltar de bzhin bdag gis deng*/ */dag pa lha yi chu dbang bskur/ */oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing dbang bskur bum chu sbyin/ de ltar bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ lus gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las ral ba'i cod pan gyi rtse mor rigs kyi bdag po 'od dpag tu med pa sprul sku'i cha byad can gyis rgyas btab/

dbang gi lha rnams rdo rje slob ma'i ba spu'i bu ga rnams su bstim/ oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swā hā/ me tog 'thor/ de la slob dpon gyis/ oṃ ārya tā re badzra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ nas/ shapada'i bar gyis mchod/ slar yang dpon slob gnyis ka bcom ldan 'das mar gsal ba'i bla ma'i zhal nas sngags kyi phreng ba mu tig gi phreng ba lta bu thon/ slob ma'i zhal du zhugs thugs kar thim pas bcom ldan 'das ma'i gsung gi byin rlabs dang dngos grub ma lus pa thob/ ngag sngags kyi mthu dang ldan par dpon slob gnyis kas bsam la/ oṃ tā re tuttā re tu re swā hā/ zhes yi ge bcu pa brgya phrag gcig dpon slob lhan cig tu bzlas pa'i mthar/ slob mas/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyi// bcom ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs// zhes lan gsum gsol/ bla mas/ maṇḍal gyi tshom bu'i me tog slob ma'i mgor bzhag cing*/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi// bcom ldan 'di la byin gyis rlobs// zhes lan gsum brjod/ sangs rgyas byang sems de dag gi thugs ka nas sngags phreng mang po spyan drangs pa slob ma'i snying gar thim pas phrin las thams cad bsgrub ba'i nus mthu dang ldan par bsam/ bla mas/ deng phyin chad 'phags ma'i snying po yi ge bcu pa spel tshig dang bcas pa chag med du bzla ba'i dam bca' gyis shig /ces bsgo| slob mas nyin rer 'di tsam bzla zhes khas blangs/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs dang*/ gtang rag gi maṇḍal dbul/ 'di la thugs kyi rjes gnang sogs byas na rung ngam snyam mod/ 'on kyang bla ma mkhas grub gong ma khungs thub kyi yig char 'di tsam las ma byung bas bod kyi yig cha rnams 'thad legs kha skong lhan thabs mang bas phung du sbyar ba mthong nas de tsam gyis chog par bgyis so// gsum pa/ mjug gi cho ga ni bum mdun gyi lha la mchod pa dang bstod pa ci rigs pa byas rjes/ oṃ ārya tā re sa ma ya ma nu pā la ya/
